simple.meaning: שְׁפוֹט (shᵉphôwṭ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a judicial sentence , i.e. punishment.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across 2 Chronicles, Ezekiel, beginning at 2 Chronicles 20:9. Its contexts include family line, death.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁפוֹט (H8196).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שְׁפוֹט (shᵉphôwṭ) / H8196 is traced through 2 Chronicles 20:9, Ezekiel 23:10 as a generated source-based concept entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: ‘If evil comes on us—the sword, judgment, pestilence, or famine—we will stand before this house, and before you (for your name is in this house), and cry to you in our affliction, and you will hear and save.’

majorEvents.label: Death
majorEvents.evidenceText: These uncovered her nakedness. They took her sons and her daughters; and they killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women; for they executed judgments on her.
